# 佛說玉耶女經

**ID:** T0142a
**Volume:** T02
**Category:** 阿含部類
**Original Category:** 阿含部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 265–316
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle anonymous Chinese translation of the discourse on the seven kinds of wife addressed by the Buddha to the daughter-in-law of Anāthapiṇḍika named Yùyē 玉耶 (Sujātā). T145 is the first of two consecutive Taishō entries (a, b) — sister-versions T142a and T142b (= [T146](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0146)).

**Abstract**

The Western Jìn (265–317) ascription is a catalog-tradition assignment. The defensible bracket is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
